name: compactor
description: Economically gated cheap-model tool-result compaction; uses cached intent when available and a bounded local fallback otherwise. Alternative to keyword_compactor — run ONE of the two; running after intent improves relevance.

permissions.name: env.shared_cache_get
permissions.description: Read optional intent:<tool_call_id> values published by the intent plugin

permissions.name: env.host_call.torana_evaluate_compaction
permissions.description: Apply model-generated replacements only when the batch has positive estimated net savings

permissions.name: env.model_complete
permissions.description: Generate summaries through the operator-bound summarizer service

permissions.name: env.model_pricing
permissions.description: Resolve only the operator-bound target and summarizer pricing resources

permissions.name: ir.tool_results.write
permissions.description: Position-keyed tool-result text value changes (compaction replacements)

model_services.name: summarizer
model_services.description: Cheap model used to summarize large tool results

pricing_resources.name: target
pricing_resources.description: Pricing for the currently routed request model

pricing_resources.name: summarizer
pricing_resources.description: Pricing for the bound summarizer model service
